title: An IndiGo co-founder is building a 500-bed hospital inside his old engineering college
sources: Business Today, August 2026 - Meet IndiGo co founder Rakesh Gangwal, who donated Rs 300 crore to IIT Kanpur
thecsruniverse.com - IndiGo co-founder Rakesh Gangwal donates Rs 100 Cr to IIT Kanpur for School of Medical Sciences and Technology
caption:
An IndiGo co-founder is building a 500-bed hospital inside his old engineering college. He's already put in Rs 400 crore of his own money.

Rakesh Gangwal, US-based co-founder of IndiGo Airlines and an IIT Kanpur alumnus, has committed Rs 400 crore total to build the Gangwal School of Medical Sciences and Technology at his alma mater - Rs 100 crore in 2022 to launch it and a further Rs 300 crore in August 2026. The plan includes a 500-bed super-speciality hospital and a 200-bed cancer care research center on campus. He has also pledged matching grants of up to Rs 300 crore to draw in other donors.

He left India to build an airline. He's using that fortune to build a hospital back where he started.
